events.text: The prior resolution put no-atlas compatibility inside model_paint and described missing atlas as an exceptional layout failure. The user correctly rejected that architecture: modeling normally precedes explicit atlas creation. Rework must route pre-Paint topology through the ordinary geometry installer and reserve atlas preservation for user-authored/imported paint only.

Reworked the Chamfer fix after the user correctly rejected the first paint-layer compatibility approach. Modeling now remains independent of Paint: before an atlas has been explicitly created or imported, Chamfer and Loop Cut use the ordinary geometry replacement path, restore authored groups and exact face colours, and keep paint-layout-stale false. Only real authored pixels enable the atlas-preserving installer. The temporary model_paint no-atlas behavior and its regression were removed. The exact Follow opening regression remains, both focused ReleaseFast suites pass, formatting and diff checks are clean, and the complete ReleaseFast editor binary builds successfully.

resolution: Fixed Chamfer Boundary on valid loop-cut meshes whose automatic paint layout has failed. The shared indexed topology installer no longer requires a live atlas: model-paint now atomically adopts the replacement raycast positions and authored opacity rows while preserving the valid no-atlas state and exact supplied UVs. Added one regression for the exact four-quad opening captured by Follow and another proving topology adoption remains legal with no atlas. ReleaseFast model-paint and mesh-edit suites pass, formatting and diff checks are clean, and the ReleaseFast editor binary builds successfully.
